name: Mao Geping Cosmetics Co., Ltd.
summary: Mao Geping Cosmetics Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2000 and based in Hangzhou, sells color cosmetics and skincare in China under the MAOGEPING and Love Keeps brands. Its products include foundation, contouring, eye and lip makeup, face creams, masks, serums, cleansers and fragrances. It also manages a makeup artistry training business, and sells through department stores, other offline channels and online stores.
